# DisclosureArrow

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:disclosure-arrow` · Kerf UI · component · Foundation

Root-scaled 18px animated open and closed disclosure indicator with configurable directions, shortest-path rotation, and right-oriented replacement icon content.

## When to use

Indicate whether a disclosure control is open with an overridable 18px root-scaled visual and shortest-path rotation behavior.

- Add a shortest-path rotating indicator to a control that owns open and closed state; author replacement icon content facing right before direction transforms are applied.

**Not when:**

- Do not use the arrow as the interactive control or accessible name by itself.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/disclosure-arrow` — exports `DisclosureArrow`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/disclosure-arrow` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/disclosure-arrow.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: foundation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- The arrow is decorative; expose expanded state through aria-expanded on its owning control and keep that control's accessible name stable.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-disclosure-arrow`.

Never put `kui-disclosure-arrow` on an element you write; render `DisclosureArrow` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-disclosure-arrow-duration`, `--kui-disclosure-arrow-size`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
